# Catalog reference

The default simulation object model (`src/sim/catalog.ts`). Ids are what you pass as `typeId` / `templateId` in the GUI, REST API and MCP tools. To add your own types see [Tutorial 9](../tutorials/09-extending-the-catalog.md).

DIS enumerations are representative values in the SISO-REF-010 layout (kind.domain.country.category.subcategory.specific.extra; country 225 = USA, 222 = Russia).

### Unmanned systems

How each unmanned type is controlled (see [Concepts](../concepts.md#unmanned-systems-and-swarms)): its datalink and range (a fibre-optic cable's length), anti-jam share, whether it relays other drones' links, what it does when the link is lost, its autonomy, the warhead of one-way attack drones, and the size the eye and thermal sights see.

## Weapons

Pk is the probability of a catastrophic kill per shot at short range against each armour class, before range, motion, concealment and armour modifiers (see [Concepts](../concepts.md#combat-and-damage)). Penetration (mm RHA equivalent) is set against the protection of the face hit; spread (mrad) and range-estimate error turn on the ballistic model for unguided rounds.
